description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports necessary modules such as React, React DOM's createRoot, the main App component, and a performance measurement utility. It retrieves the root DOM element, initializes a React root, renders the App component within React's StrictMode, and optionally reports web vitals for performance analysis.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the React application tree inside the root DOM element.
